entries.title: Connect Google for private testing
entries.body: Google is now available in Settings → Integrations for Gmail and Calendar. Mail and calendar changes ask for your approval. Google still warns that Infinitary is unverified, and some accounts cannot connect.

picture.alt: Settings → Integrations offers Google beside GitHub and MCP server.

exclusions.reason: Internal privacy, permission, demonstration and CASA drafts; not a published policy, completed submission or verification approval.
